_comment: Template only. Copy to a PRIVATE file outside the release folder, replace every <<...>> with the exact original string (case-sensitive), and never publish the filled file. redact_verify.py refuses to run while any secret still contains '<<'. Longest secrets are applied first automatically. Tokens: the first candidate that does not occur anywhere in the originals is used.
